page.layout: One column of index entries on the left, with the title "INDEX X." centred above it; the right side is blank.; Two columns of index entries: a left column, visible only in its lower part, then a right column from top to bottom. No page number, running head or catchword.

main_text.l: dies usurarum olim, cuius iusq; mensis Idus. 299

page.notes: Blue ink strokes and underlines sit over several page numbers (for example 90, 91, 192, 136, 250, 166, 281); they are annotations, not printed text, and are not transcribed. The last line is at the lower edge and only partly legible. The numbers "nis.162" at the top are the end of a line that begins above this part, so this is a fragment and stays one. The printed spelling "ambignitate" and "volũ" is copied as it appears. Left column: its upper lines are hidden by a blank area, so the first line is partly unreadable. The word "cuius" in "dies usurarum olim, cuius" is doubtful, and "iusq;" may be "iufq;". The line "Doctoratus bonor qualis" is joined from a hyphenated break. Hyphens are kept only where printed.
